title: “I'll do it tomorrow” often turns into deadline-day panic, warns income tax dept ahead of 31 July ITR due date
text: With the July 31 deadline for income tax return filing nearing, the tax department urges taxpayers to file early to avoid last-minute stress and errors. Details here.

title: 8th Pay Commission not required to brief Centre during deliberations, Finance Ministry tells Rajya Sabha
text: The Finance Ministry has clarified in Parliament that the 8th Pay Commission is not required to share regular progress updates with the Centre. The Commission has autonomy, may determine its own procedures under the ToR, and will submit its final recommendations after 18 months, the minister said.

title: Why child-free couples may need more—not less—for retirement
text: Conventional wisdom says child-free couples need a smaller retirement corpus. In reality, longer retirements, caregiving costs and the absence of a family safety net can make financial planning more demanding.

title: Can you change the income tax regime while filing ITR? Here's what taxpayers should know
text: Salaried taxpayers can switch between the old and new tax regimes while filing their ITR, regardless of the regime used by their employer for TDS. However, rules differ for those with business income. Understanding the flexibility and tax impact can help taxpayers make an informed choice.

text: The Sajjan Jindal-led B2B marketplace joins India’s growing digital commerce listing pipeline as it prepares for a public debut.

title: UCO Bank plans $500-million overseas fundraise
text: UCO Bank plans to raise $500 million through foreign currency deposits and overseas borrowings. This move joins other lenders accessing the central bank's concessional funding window. The facility has already attracted over $32 billion in foreign currency inflows. Non-resident deposits have been the primary driver of this significant mobilization. This initiative aims to strengthen India's foreign exchange reserves effectively.

title: PPFAS valuation climbs after Rajeev Thakkar sells stake to WhiteOak AIF
text: Rajeev Thakkar sold a stake in PPFAS to WhiteOak Capital's AIF. This transaction valued the unlisted asset management company at nearly ₹15,800 crore. Promoters Neil and Khushboo Parikh also recently sold a stake in PPFAS. These deals provide valuation insights for the closely held company. PPFAS reported increased revenue and net profit in the last fiscal year.

title: D-St set for a positive opening as GIFT Nifty signals firm start
text: Indian stock markets experienced a muted trading session on Tuesday. The Sensex and Nifty indices erased early gains to close in the red. Broader markets showed mixed performance, with small caps declining and mid caps advancing. The Indian rupee strengthened for a third consecutive session against the US dollar. Foreign investors were net sellers, while domestic institutions were net buyers.

title: Stocks in news: L&T, Tata Capital, Ambuja Cements, Suzlon Energy, RVNL
text: Indian stock markets closed lower on Tuesday after early gains faded. Larsen & Toubro and Tata Capital reported strong profit growth for the quarter. Ambuja Cement and Suzlon Energy, however, saw their profits decline year-on-year. RVNL announced a record date for its final dividend and secured a new order. Phoenix Mills posted a profit increase, while VST Industries experienced a profit drop.

title: 100% US tariffs incoming for India? Russia sanctions bill authored by late Lindsey Graham clears first Senate hurdle
text: The bill was passed soon after the funeral of late Senator Lindsey Graham, who was its author.

title: US-Iran war LIVE: US and Saudi Arabia launch joint strikes on Iran-backed groups in Iraq
text: US-Iran war LIVE: TUS military says it conducted joint strikes with Saudi Arabia in Iraq against Iran-aligned militant groups directed by the IRGC to target US forces and Saudi energy infrastructure. CENTCOM says the attacks on US forces were unsuccessful.

title: US Senate confirms Trump-nominee Jay Clayton as Director of National Intelligence: Who is he?
text: The US Senate confirmed Jay Clayton as Director of National Intelligence in a 51-47 party-line vote. Democrats opposed his nomination over his refusal to explicitly acknowledge Joe Biden's 2020 election victory and concerns about political influence on intelligence agencies.

title: American Airlines flights resume after IT outage causes groundings across US
